evidence: minisvc/storage/repo.py:17-22 inserts directly into SQLite with one per-call connection and no retry or busy-timeout setup
impact: Transient file-lock or I/O issues can fail writes at once and lose requests unless the caller retries
mitigation: Add bounded retry and error mapping around writes; consider sqlite timeout or busy handling and request-level tests

evidence: minisvc/audit.py:4-10 creates dict payloads only; minisvc/storage/repo.py:11-29 defines and uses only the orders table
impact: No durable audit trail exists for created or read events
mitigation: Add an audit table plus repository methods or a transaction-aware audit sink

evidence: minisvc/config.py:10-14 defaults MINISVC_DB to relative path orders.sqlite; minisvc/cli.py:8-11 uses it as-is
impact: Database location changes with process working directory and can create data in the wrong place
mitigation: Require an absolute configured path in deployed environments or resolve relative paths from a known app root

evidence: minisvc/config.py:10-14 parses MINISVC_READONLY, but no caller uses Settings.readonly
impact: Operators can set readonly and still allow writes, which breaks safety expectations
mitigation: Enforce readonly in create paths or repository save methods and add a test for it

evidence: minisvc/api/handlers.py:7-10 reads payload keys directly and casts total_cents with int(...)
impact: Missing keys or bad types will raise exceptions instead of returning controlled client errors
mitigation: Add schema validation and explicit 4xx error responses at the handler or adapter boundary

evidence: minisvc/api/handlers.py:12 and minisvc/storage/repo.py:18-22 do not catch sqlite3.IntegrityError or other DB exceptions
impact: Duplicate order IDs or DB failures likely bubble up as unhandled errors
mitigation: Translate storage exceptions into stable API responses and add duplicate-id coverage

evidence: minisvc/cli.py:9-10 runs init_schema only in the CLI path; API route registration does not ensure schema exists
impact: An HTTP deployment that skips CLI bootstrap can hit missing-table failures on first request
mitigation: Move schema init into app startup or repository construction used by the HTTP stack
